<STBG 1,0><BGM 0,0,503><CHAR 5,1,8,4,0><TALK 5><NAME 9><CHAR 1,1,1,0,3><CV 2,5>We did it, meow!
The waterway is restored, meow!

<TALK 0><NAME 0>Thank you!
We thank you on behalf of the villagers!

With this and the <COL C70101FF>Green Wolf</COL>,
ominous things keep happening...
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,2><COL C70101FF>Soul-Returning Green Wolf</COL>...?

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,16>It's enshrined in this archipelago, meow!
But it's been strange lately, meow...

<TALK 0><NAME 0>Yes...
To appease it, Lady Yuno
performs a rite of gathering vessels.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1><CV 1,20>Lady Yuno...
Yuno!?

<TALK 0><NAME 0>Lady Yuno!?
Why in such a place...

No, you're in the middle of the ritual.
All the villagers pray for its success!

<TALK 4><NAME 9><CV 2,11>Meow meow?
Why are you hiding, meow!
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,7>Yuno...

...Let's go on ahead!
Excuse us!

<STBG 1,2><BGM 1,0,503><CHAR 1,2,1,0,0><CHAR 4,2,8,4,0><CHAR 5,2,11,0,0><STBG 2,1><BGM 0,0,503><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CHAR 5,1,11,0,0>We came out in a rush,
but what do we do now...
<TALK 5><NAME 13>I'm sorry...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,60>Still, to think Yuno had such a role...
Must be hard alone...

<TALK 5><NAME 13>No, um, not alone...
while chasing this one, we got separated...
<TALK 1><NAME 1>Then we must reunite with that person...
Eh, you'll come along...

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,8>Right!
If we go to the ritual vessels,
we might meet that person!

<CV 1,6><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0>Yuno, let's look for the vessels together!
Travel's best with company, right!

<CV 1,9>Anyway, let's do our best together
to the ritual vessels!
<CLS>
